folder_archiver.py.summary: Archive folders with the ``shutil`` formats and optionally remove them.
details: The ``create`` subcommand packs each given folder as tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz or zip (``-f``), names the archive after the folder, deletes the source with ``--cleanup`` and previews with ``--dry-run``.

folderize.py.summary: Sort the files of a tree into alphabetically named folders.
details: Creates the ``A``-``Z``/``_`` folders (or a numeric split), moves each file into the folder matching the first character of its name, cleans up the emptied directories and previews with ``--dry-run``.

folderize_by_sim_names.py.summary: Group the Lua files of a tree into folders with similar names.
details: Normalizes the file names, clusters the similar ones and moves each cluster into a folder named after it (``--apply`` does the moves; otherwise the plan is printed).

Subcommands: ``convert`` rewrites the TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 fonts in another container, ``otf2ttf`` and ``otf2ttf-fontforge`` outline the OTF fonts as TTF (fontTools or FontForge), ``tottf`` uses the FontForge CLI for SVG/WOFF/EOT/OTF/TTC and ``woff22ttf`` decompresses WOFF2; ``-r`` removes the sources and the work runs in parallel.

fontpreview.py.summary: Generate HTML pages that preview the fonts of a directory.
details: The ``simple`` subcommand writes one block per font at the given sizes, ``rich`` a page with editable sample areas and a dark mode; the sample text and the sizes come from the ``--preset`` (Persian by default) or from ``--text``/``--sizes``.

format_python_code.py.summary: Merged Python formatter and source rewriter.
details: Subcommands: ``fixcode``/``fixindent``/``tokenformat`` repair the indentation, ``reflow`` rewraps the comments and docstrings, ``astor`` round-trips through astor, ``ruff`` runs ``ruff format``, ``sort`` writes a ``*_sorted`` file with the top-level nodes ordered and ``format`` applies black, isort, autoflake, autopep8 or yapf.

furls.py.summary: Collect the URLs found in the files and archives of a tree.
details: Scans the text files and the members of the zip/tar/zst/br archives (nested archives included, size limit via ``-m``), extracts every ``http(s)`` link, separates the GitHub ones and saves ``urls.txt`` plus ``gitlinks.txt``/``repos.txt``.

fuzzy_dedup.py.summary: Find and manage the exact and fuzzy duplicate files.
details: Hashes the files, groups the exact duplicates and the ones above a similarity threshold (ssdeep), and the ``scan``/``report``/``move`` subcommands copy, move, delete or export the groups as CSV, JSON or a similarity matrix.

fztrans.py.summary: Offline Persian to English (and back) dictionary lookup.
details: Searches ``~/dic.json`` for a word, lists the entries by ``--prefix``, does a typo-tolerant ``--fuzzy`` search and, unless ``--no-fzf`` is given, lets fzf pick among the candidates; the results are printed with the Persian shaping of ``faprint``.

g1.py.summary: Clone a GitHub repository through a pluggable backend.
details: Accepts ``owner/repo``, HTTPS or SSH identifiers, resolves the default branch and the size through the GitHub API (``--token`` raises the rate limit), warns about the large repositories, can clone shallowly (``-d``) and initialises the submodules; ``--backend`` picks subprocess, Dulwich, GitPython, libgit2 or typer.

gdrive_sync.py.summary: Download or mirror the content of a Google Drive folder.
details: The ``download`` and ``sync`` subcommands authenticate read-only with the OAuth client (``credentials.json``/``.env``, or the out-of-band ``--auth-mode manual``), walk the folder tree, sanitize the names and fetch the files into the destination, skipping the up-to-date ones unless ``--force``.
Scans the root directory, prints the sizes as a tree with human-readable units, and supports ``--max-depth``, ``--exclude`` globs and ``--follow-symlinks``.

gdupfunc.py.summary: Detect duplicate Python code with subinterpreters.
details: Normalizes each file's AST (optionally alpha-renaming the variables, ``--disable-fuzzy`` turns that off), ignores the small nodes (``--min-nodes``), reports the duplicates and also writes an HTML report; ``--max-duplicates`` turns the run into a CI check.

Pre-hashes the file heads, confirms with a 128 KB-chunked xxhash, keeps one copy per set and only deletes with the explicit ``-r``; ``-l`` lists the duplicates and ``-b`` benchmarks xxhash against hashlib.

get_keys.py.summary: Extract the keys or the values of a JSON file into a text file.
details: Flattens the nested document, writes one key (or one value) per line to ``keys.txt``/``values.txt`` or to ``-o``, sorts them with ``--sort`` and deduplicates the result.

get_latest_pkgs_added_to_pypi.py.summary: Fetch the latest package updates from the PyPI RSS feed.
details: Parses the feed into records (name, version, date, link) and saves the newest ``-n`` entries as JSON, CSV or text (``-f``), by default all of them in ``pypi_updates.json``.
